response.sql: WITH long_rental_films AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_rate_per_duration, COUNT(*) as film_count FROM long_rental_films GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_duration) as benchmark_value FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_rate_per_duration, r.film_count, r.avg_rate_per_duration / b.benchmark_value as ratio_to_benchmark FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.benchmark_value IS NOT NULL
